purpose: Document first-party Spanish cadastral discovery and bounded anonymous geometry review.
assessment: Official DGC documentation confirms public INSPIRE cadastral-parcel WFS and WMS services. Granada municipal first-party records confirm cadastral parcel use in planning documents and reference the municipal GeoGranada viewer. Anonymous requests from this environment did not return a usable schema or parcel geometry, so no sample was retained.
registryAssessment: National registry/service custodian evidenced: Dirección General del Catastro. Local municipal map/planning custodian evidenced: Ayuntamiento de Granada. No separate Granada cadastral registry API was verified.

officialPrimarySources.observation: DGC documents INSPIRE cadastral-parcel dataset, WMS, WFS, and municipal ATOM services.
DGC documents public WMS and GETFEATUREINFO for cadastral parcel references.
DGC WFS specification documents CP.CadastralParcel BBOX requests, EPSG:25830 examples, and service limits.
Ayuntamiento de Granada references a municipal GeoGranada viewer and cadastral parcel identity in an official street-numbering record.
Official municipal planning PDF includes Granada parcel/cadastral mapping; it is not a live parcel API.
